scope: Additional scenario-materiality review only. This does not approve imports or certify the full 41-record source-evidence gate.

policy.note: Kattis pages returned 403/blocked to the available browser fetcher. Where an official contest statement or an independent index was accessible, it is cited below. Claims without the actual statement are explicitly left provisional.

records.title: Wood Cutting
records.reasoning: An accessible solution reference describes the task as grouping each customer's wood pieces, summing processing time, sorting customers by total work, and minimizing average waiting time. This is a recognizable customer-queue story, but the available evidence points to a compact shortest-job-first exercise rather than a long scenario. Alberta 2016 provenance is not independently established by the retrieved page.

evidence.supports: Links the exact Kattis slug and explains the customer waiting-time / shortest-job-first reduction.

records.action: Keep as a normal greedy/queueing practice problem; do not count as long-scenario without the original statement and a documented depth rationale.

The statement is self-contained and short; it is a useful constructive/DP exercise but does not meet a long-scenario standard.

With N at most 10, it is a small exhaustive-search exercise. The theme is memorable, but the statement is not long or multi-stage.
